newsitem.title: CHINA: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.
newsitem.headline: China interbank market rates (CHIBOR) mostly down.

text.p: Following is the China Interbank Offered Rate (CHIBOR) for Thursday issued by the official Xinhua news agency on behalf of the People's Bank of China, the central bank.
The figures represent weighted averages and not closing prices and are annual percentage rates.
The central bank does not post volumes.
Traders said the rates moved slightly down in dull trading as a result of the poor debut of the seven-year bond on the Shanghai stock exchange today, depressing market sentiment.

"With the end of issue of the seven-year bond yesterday, state banks had more money to offer today," said one trader. "But the poor debut of the bond on the treasury bond spot market prevented securities houses from borrowing to trade there."
Traders expect the rates to move in a narrow range in the next few days, with no market-moving news in prospect.
